title: The Lightning Network Explained (Litecoin/Bitcoin)
summary: An 8-minute explainer on the Lightning Network and how it relates to Segwit, Bitcoin and Litecoin. It covers how off-chain payment channels route payments to scale blockchain transactions.
why: Commenters point to it as a short, high-level overview of how Lightning payment channels work.
